purpose: One bounded joint economic comparison of three mechanistically distinct and Cloud-native single-symbol H1 OHLCV families; neither an indicator parameter grid nor reinterpretation of any closed prior exact configuration.

source.originalQuoteCost: existing research.multiscale_conditional_research.extract_costs and integrated_predictive_funded.cost_context; observed spreads, commission, FX conversion, current minimum volumes/margins; modeled slippage not broker fills

clock.signal: ONE_HOUR_CLOSED_H1_BAR_ONLY; every H1 reconstructed from exact 12 complete contiguous original M5 OHLCV bars; no weekend/session imputation; past 20 complete contiguous H1 required.
clock.sourceEntry: at t+5m next exact completed M5 close, not market fill
clock.sourceExit: exact completed M5 close at t+65m, all 13 holding M5 closes required, no boundary-cross phase
clock.unobservedPrice: unknown; no forward fill, no proxy invent

families.premise: A new 20h high/low close on actual tick-activity expansion reflects persistent directional order flow; the next 60 minutes may follow the completed breakout.
families.signal: If current closed H1 close > highest prior 20 complete H1 highs AND current H1 tick volume >=1.2x median prior 20 hourly tick volumes, buy; if close < minimum prior 20 lows and same activity criterion, sell; otherwise abstain.
families.cloudNative: cTrader Algo Bars HighPrices/LowPrices/TickVolumes, Donchian-style max/min, Math median; no proprietary indicator dependency

families.premise: An H1 closing price outside the prior 20 completed hour-closes' two-sigma band may reflect transient inventory dislocation that reverses over the next 60 minutes.
families.signal: Compute arithmetic mean and population sigma of the prior 20 complete H1 closes, excluding the current H1. If z=(currentClose-mean)/sigma>=2, SELL; if z<=-2, BUY; if sigma<=0, abstain.
families.cloudNative: cTrader Algo BollingerBands or equivalent custom C# mean and population-standard-deviation on closed Bars

families.premise: A completed H1 that pierces the previous 12-hour extreme and closes back inside the old range, with a dominant rejection wick, can reverse as stop liquidity is absorbed.
families.signal: After 12 previous complete contiguous H1 candles, if current high>prior12 maxHigh, current close<prior12 maxHigh, current low>=prior12 minLow, upper wick>=0.45 of nonzero full H1 range: short. Mirror at the lower low for long. If both sides/ambiguous, abstain.
families.cloudNative: cTrader Algo Bars OHLC; pure C# math, no future fractal confirmation or chart draw required

benchmarks.primary: same target, same decision clock and holding; sign of completed prior 4h H1 close change; pays same instrument modeled adverse roundtrip cost for nonflat side
benchmarks.secondary: EUR300 cash-flat, zero fees zero trades
benchmarks.singleAssetCost: central, adverse and stress per original target from preexisting authenticated current-term quote contexts, using exactly integrated_predictive_funded.cost_context
benchmarks.grossPriceBasis: target M5 source close-to-close, not actual bid/ask fill

statistics.f2: existing f2_preflight.prospective_economic_futility at 26 development calendar week means including empty weeks; 3-lag HAC, Bonferroni six comparisons, no selection outcomes until family F2 passes
statistics.selection: 13 calendar-week mean adverse net vs flat and incremental adverse net vs same-clock 4h momentum, one-sided HAC(3) Bonferroni six-comparison lower confidence bounds; both >0 required
statistics.risk: No hyperparameter choice, symbol winner choice or threshold relaxation after observed returns; all eligible instrument cases pooled equally within active week; no post-hoc salvage
statistics.close: If authentic source/contract/cost gate fails, or development F2 fails, or selection paired net lower not positive, close exact family without retuning, inversion, selection rescore or audit score
